input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: TrueLink's only warranty (Section 9) is a Year 2000 date-processing warranty; there is no warranty that the Interface or related software conforms to its documentation, no services warranty, and no repair/replace or refund remedy anywhere in the Agreement (searches for documentation/conformance and refund/re-performance remedies returned nothing; Sections 3 and 4 impose only reasonable-efforts hosting and support obligations). That fails every fallback element, so we insert the shortest fallback warranty: 90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day services warranty, and repair, replacement or refund. The Section 12 disclaimer is prefaced \"EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT,\" so it does not swallow the inserted express warranty and needs no amendment.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that (i) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and (ii) for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner. Client's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at TrueLink's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or Services, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming software or Services.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only a Year 2000 warranty, so TrueLink stands behind nothing else in its performance. We have added our fallback warranty: 90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day services warranty, with repair, replacement or refund as the remedy.
proposal.summary: Insert TrueLink performance warranty (90-day software conformance, 30-day services) with repair/replace or refund remedy

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
